spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's own canonical use case (vertical feed of overflow:auto-clip carousels, alignment on the cards) and measures the propagation contract rather than simulating it.

interactive.rationale: Real scrollable feed and lanes, a feature-vs-workaround mode toggle that rewrites the live CSS, a measured vertical-snap check, and scrollsnapchange-driven settle readouts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises working horizontal pagination plus an honest measurement of the vertical half; the page does both.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the workaround-wrapper strategy, the feature-mode trap on pre-157 engines, and distinguishes clip-preserved from clip-coerced browsers in both the banner and verdicts.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5086608215900160 and the explainer's multi-carousel-feed section.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite covers the propagation and hidden-traps contracts this page demonstrates; no page-specific suite needed.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (cloud fallback, no chrome-devtools-mcp): workaround mode measured 260→301 snapped to the shelf edge, feature mode honestly stayed at 295 (card edge 336), lane settle reported card 2 with snapTargetInline 'Orbital', zero console errors/failed requests, desktop+mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for workaround-snaps, propagation-active, and the labelled honest-unsupported fallback.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, aria-pressed toggle styled with outline on light background keeping AA, 44px controls, scroll-state snapped-card enhancement inverts both background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Lanes and feed are keyboard-focusable with aria-labels, mode buttons expose aria-pressed, readouts are role=status aria-live=polite, shelf sections carry labels.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: zero horizontal document overflow, lanes scroll within their own axis, controls stack and stay tappable.

openQuestions.title: Capture the feature-mode success measurement on a 157+ engine
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium with SingleAxisScrollContainersForScrollSnap active, the feature-mode measured check should settle on the card edge (propagation) and the scroll-state snapped-card highlight plus feed scrollsnapchange target should reflect the lane's cards. Verify and note the measured numbers.

guidanceConsulted.query: scroll snap carousel accessible keyboard scrolling
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: React to the settled snap target with scrollsnapchange and its snapTargetBlock/snapTargetInline members.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both the lanes and the feed report settles via scrollsnapchange (snapTargetInline card title, snapTargetBlock element), with a scrollend+measurement fallback.

guidanceConsulted.query: scroll snap carousel accessible keyboard scrolling
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Mark the currently snapped item with container-type: scroll-state and an @container scroll-state(snapped: x) query instead of JS observers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each poster is a scroll-state container; the snapped card inverts its title chip purely in CSS, degrading silently where scroll-state queries are unsupported.

summary: The explainer's canonical product pattern built honestly for a pre-157 browser: horizontal pagination measured working (card 2 at scrollLeft 166), vertical card snap measured absent in feature mode and working via the labelled wrapper workaround (260→301), with exact flag guidance. Verified headless Chromium 141 cloud fallback, both viewports clean.
